changed: Deterministic explanation projection (Q5, G11, ADR 0033): contracts/explain.py (Explanation, RunHeader, RuleRef, Completeness, ValueLabel) and the pure kernel/explain.py explain(ledger, reconstructed): goal, source facts (evidence ids, revisions), validation (rules evaluated and open findings as rule id, version, status), proposal digest, approval (actor, policy version), receipt, verified outcome; partial for pre-key runs. Evidence bundle key `explanation` (additive), `e-agent explain <run_id>` in cli.py and README. Review fixes: driver id read from run.created via Reconstructed.driver (C3-26); ProgressLedger.rules_evaluated across every validation of the run (C3-27); explained findings carry no validator message (C3-29). pyproject.toml adds kernel.explain to the facade contract. Commits d1e767f, de94270, d4b67f8; plan rulings in 457e282; reviews harness/state/3/reviews/3c.3.json, 3c.3-r1.json.
open_items: Owner: rule_bundle_version is in no event payload (only inside the approval digest), so the explanation does not name it; recording it needs an ADR 0031 §3 key (C3-27). Asked: Add or Skip.
ADR 0033's CQ06 row lists expected/observed, which its own section excludes (PR-26); the plan records the ruling, the ADR row wording needs an owner amendment (C3-28).
make e2e not run for the new bundle key; the UI evidence selector reads named keys only.

rulings.ruling: CQ06 leaves findings' expected/observed out of the explanation (PR-26); the bundle's events keep them.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An auditor reads values from the events rather than the explanation.

rulings.ruling: rules_evaluated spans every validation of the run (first-seen order, latest status), because a two-step plan's latest validation has no findings.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A repaired run lists the superseded proposal's rules too, with their latest status.

rulings.ruling: Explained findings drop the validator message: a plugin validator could put a value in free text.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: The explanation is terser; the message stays in the events and the ledger.
